name: Hardsole No. 4 Work Boot
description: A blocky, ankle-high work boot with a sole recycled from conveyor belt rubber and an upper of stiff synth-leather that never quite softened. The toe cap is a salvaged steel plate held by rivets that don't quite match. Every pair looks slightly different because they're assembled from whatever was available that week.
functionality: Basic steel toe protection. Waterproof for the first six months.
what_it_says: You work a physical job and you can't afford to lose your feet. Practical to the point of gracelessness.
story_hooks: A pair is found with a serial number scratched out — someone didn't want to be traced back to a work site.
The boot's sole contains embedded gravel from a specific district, useful for tracking a person's movements.
